lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 2, 4, and 7 from the posterior exhibit termination before reaching the ventral boundary. The three most anterior lines are fragmented into series of vertical dashes.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot on the lower cheek; high-contrast white band traversing the lower throat/neck region; distinct white markings on the mid-forelimb and hindlimbs.
